1.05 Use of Digital Signature Certificates and Aadhar e-Sign
DGFT allows submission of applications authenticated through digital signature
certificate (DSC) issued by any approved entity of Controller of Certifying Authority of
India or through Aadhar e Sign in online environment.

1.07 Generation of e BRC where payments are realised through Insurance
Agencies
(a) An applicant realising export proceeds through Insurance Agency will approach
the concerned RA with the proof of payment issued by the concerned Insurance
Agency.

1.12 Appeal
An applicant, who is not satisfied with decision taken to suspend or cancel Status
Certificate, may file an appeal to DGFT within 45 days.
